sentences: Directed feedback problems seek a small deletion set that eliminates all directed cycles.
The saved survey question asks for fixed-parameter algorithms with single-exponential dependence on the deletion budget.
It also includes the vertex-deletion case on planar directed graphs.
Such a bound would replace more costly parameter growth with a clearer exponential search scale.

The source question spans distinct variants, so an algorithm for planar vertex deletion would not automatically settle the unrestricted vertex and arc cases, and subsequent status has not been audited here.
